structured_output.summary:
The S6 menu now uses the desktop layout from UI_RULES §5, the same way the HUD does. In src/ui/start-screen.ts, createStartScreen calls the existing watchDesktop from layout.ts and toggles `is-desktop` on the start overlay element. src/ui/title.css gets new `.ui-start.is-desktop` rules, all from tokens:
- --type-display-size-desktop on the h1 (96px)
- --type-title-size-desktop on SELECT TRACK and RACE (48px)
- --type-button-size-desktop on card names and --type-label-size-desktop on BEST
- --desktop-outline (4px) on the cards, card plates, RACE and the brand panel's divider
- --desktop-margin (32px) padding on both panels instead of the 48px safe insets
- --desktop-scale applied to card width, gaps, plate padding, the stripes, the title car, and RACE's height, padding and icon

The phone view is unchanged: the 844×390 screenshot matches the one before the fix. At 1440×900 the screenshot now shows the scaled layout. The new test, tests/ui/desktop-start-screen.test.ts, renders the start--menu stage in Chromium through harness/screens/browser.ts, as desktop-hud.test.ts does. It checks that the phone keeps 56/32/32/22px type and 3px outlines, and that desktop gets 96/48/48/28px type, 4px outlines, cards more than 1.4× wider, and 32px margins. It failed before the fix (the heading was 56px, not 96px) and passes after. pnpm typecheck passes and pnpm test passes (113 files, 738 tests).
